iti111:2.1: sampannasīlā bhikkhave hotha sampannapātimokkhā pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha ācāragocarasampannā aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvino samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesu.
iti111:3.1: sampannasīlānaṃ bhikkhave bhavataṃ sampannapātimokkhānaṃ pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutānaṃ viharataṃ ācāragocarasampannānaṃ aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvīnaṃ samādāya sikkhataṃ sikkhāpadesu kimassa bhikkhave uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ
iti111:4.1: carato cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno abhijjhā vigatā hoti byāpādo vigato hoti thīnamiddhaṃ vigataṃ hoti uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigataṃ hoti vicikicchā pahīnā hoti āraddhaviriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ
iti111:4.2: caraṃpi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitattoti vuccati.
iti111:5.1: ṭhitassa cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno abhijjhā vigatā hoti byāpādo vigato hoti thīnamiddhaṃ vigataṃ hoti uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigataṃ hoti vicikicchā pahīnā hoti āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ
iti111:5.2: ṭhitopi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitattoti vuccati.
iti111:6.1: nisinnassa cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno abhijjhā vigatā hoti byāpādo vigato hoti thīnamiddhaṃ vigataṃ hoti uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigataṃ hoti vicikicchā pahīnā hoti āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ
iti111:6.2: nisinnopi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriya pahitattoti vuccati.
iti111:7.1: sayānassa cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno jāgarassa abhijjhā vigatā hoti byāpādo vigato hoti thīnamiddhaṃ vigataṃ hoti uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigataṃ hoti vicikicchā pahīnā hoti āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ
iti111:7.2: sayānopi bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgaro evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitattoti vuccatīti.
